subject: Business Models
title: The Franchise Disclosure Document
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Franchise Disclosure Document.

hook.text: Before you buy a franchise, US law requires a 100+ page disclosure document. Most people don't read it.

buildup.text: The FDD lists fees, litigation history, franchisee success rates, and financial obligations.

discovery.text: Item 19 shows actual earnings data. Shockingly, many franchisors choose not to disclose this—it's optional.

twist.text: Some FDDs reveal that 30-40% of franchisees close within 5 years. It's buried in the fine print.

climax.text: The FDD is your best protection as a buyer—but only if you read it carefully with a franchise attorney.

punchline.text: 100 pages of truth. Most franchisees sign without reading.

quiz.question: What does Item 19 of the FDD contain?
